General Information

What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Front Brake Hose that goes to the Brake Caliper.
This hose will fit the caliper on either side of the car.
Suzuki OEM Part
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Front Brake Hose (Fits LH side or RH side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
